candidate: The base plus the commit carrying this file. The run used that working tree.
method: Every GroundCore.Step call goes through CountingQueryView, a forwarding view over a real Bepu query view with no exclusions, under one read lease. Each tick counts the calls the step makes. Default MoveTuning, foot radius fraction 0.5, dt 1/30, 30 ticks per scene, each tick fed the previous result's feet.

scenes_described.flat: Floor, 3 m/s along X from the origin.
scenes_described.stairs: Six risers of 0.25 on treads of 0.35, 3 m/s along X from x -1. The run reaches the top tread.
scenes_described.wall: Floor with a wall face at x 1, 4 m/s at 30 degrees off the wall normal from (0, -2). The shell meets the wall on tick 6 and slides along it.

budget.rule: Per tick with n substeps. Two support probes, each one sweep and at most one feature query, at the start and in each substep's down pass. One lift sweep. Up to 1 + MaxSlides (5) shell sweeps per substep. Recovery takes up to 1 + MaxRecoveryPasses (5) penetration tests, and each substep up to 2 clearance tests plus one touch normal per shell sweep. No raycasts.

not_measured.stairs_mesh: Blocked by https://github.com/APKiwiOrg/KhaozEngine/issues/1342. At 3 m/s the first substep axis lands 1.94e-7 past the first nosing, the feature query is Unresolved, and the body stalls there, so its counts would not describe a stair climb.
not_measured.time_and_allocation: Not measured here. #1334 also asks for per down pass time and allocation against the legacy stepper.

reading: An unobstructed tick costs 6 sweeps, 2 penetration tests, 4 feature queries and no raycasts. That is 2 start probes, the lift, 1 shell sweep and 2 down pass probes, with the recovery test and one clearance test. A wall slide adds one shell sweep on the ticks where the shell slides. Feature queries sit at their budget of 2 per down pass on every tick.
